content: Resume M0110/W0112 from current canonical source and P102 after Applied SC0009. Activate the local cdev device path, use manage-host-privilege for every sudo/su or privileged driver operation, and preserve Nix-first tool resolution. Prove live CPU Add/Copy and registered-memory/DMA import through /dev/metafluxctl and /dev/metafluxN, then qualify replacement-generation isolation and the Linux 6.12/6.18 fault matrix required by the W0112 Exit Gate.

Content revision 3a79e8e adds generation to CdevBackendBinding, injects kDeviceGeneration in the daemon binding, rejects a valid stale backend binding for new COPY/LAUNCH work after lifecycle commit, and preserves the captured binding for pending-operation drain. Focused cdev worker CTest passed 1/1; serial development build passed; full development CTest passed 86/86 with the live cdev test explicitly skipped because /dev/metaflux0 is absent.

P103 records a medium-roast bounded synthesis under the W0112/source owners. No new DNNNN or SCNNNN is required because this is a host-independent implementation correction within existing lifecycle and backend authority. Daemon rebind, live registered-memory/DMA import, and Linux sanitizer/fault qualification remain open.

Content revision 16707ec repairs cdev paired-ring page alignment and makes every worker control fd negotiate view/generation before lease. It rejects registered-memory requests before pinning when the standalone virtual cdev has no DMA mask or parent master. Linux 6.18 Kbuild and CMake build passed; cdev client/worker CTest passed 1/1 each; full development CTest passed 86/86 with live skipped after module unload. Governed live qualification reached the registered-memory stage and returned exit 77 with registered-memory DMA target unavailable.

$roast classified page alignment, worker negotiation, and explicit DMA capability boundary as medium claims under source canonical owners; no new DNNNN/SCNNNN. The host-only no-DMA-master fact remains session-only. W0112 daemon Add/Copy, real registered-memory import, replacement drain, and fault qualification remain open.
